source_set: REQUIRED_SOURCES from tools/run_autonomous_anchor_refinement.py excluding this review, plus math_qualification.py; binary and Python are separately bound by the executable receipt.
authorization_scope: One new public-start finite same-prefix autonomous-anchor experiment. This review authorizes only the frozen scope; it does not authorize retries, supplied fitted anchors, budget expansion, candidate promotion or interval/coverage claims.

mathematics.common_objective: Identical full public two-component mixture prior in the original 16D entering chart, conditioned on common entering/path support. Its support normalizer is constant across feasible points and cancels in comparison. No posterior-derived prior, duplicated source interval or truth term is introduced.
mathematics.prior_majorizer: For equal kernel covariance P, prior Hessian = P^-1 minus a positive semidefinite responsibility term. G + P^-1 is a full joint optimization metric; it is neither the exact objective Hessian nor posterior precision. No global likelihood majorization is asserted.
mathematics.feasible_geometry: With charge extrema including zero, z0-Cmax*exp(-logQ) and 1-z0+Cmin*exp(-logQ) are concave, so their superlevel support and the entering box are convex in the original chart. Feasible chords are feasible in real arithmetic; represented candidates and trials still require raw nonnegative support slacks without tolerance or clipping.
mathematics.proposal: Quadratic model uses the full Gram and exact cached mixture gradient, fixed public-SD coordinates, and the intersection of physical/path support with a one-public-SD step box. Original scaled matrix must be finite, exactly symmetric and Cholesky-positive without damping or repair. KKT uses actual intersected bounds, with artificial and physical activity separately reported.
mathematics.chronology: Every evaluator starts from the candidate time-zero entering state over the unchanged ordered 252000-record prefix. The accepted endpoint is reported; it is not substituted as a new time-zero initial state. Accepted audit gradient/Gram is reused as the next anchor without a repeated model pass.
mathematics.acceptance: Finite candidate requires resolved negative computed gradient dot direction and resolved positive quadratic decrease. First feasible trial satisfying the frozen exact-prior nonlinear Armijo comparison is accepted. Full step uses the exact returned candidate; fractions below one use the prescribed represented chord. One prior and one likelihood block own source interval [0,252000) at cursor 252000.
mathematics.arithmetic_scope: Inherited cost gamma uses unit roundoff 2^-53. New direction/model/combine guards intentionally use epsilon 2^-52 and explicit underflow terms. The guards account for arithmetic of computed operands and stored sums, not a full model/libm or derivative error certificate; they are not voltage, truth or uncertainty acceptance thresholds.
mathematics.stopping: A finite direction may be accepted despite unresolved inner KKT when the separate descent and nonlinear acceptance checks pass. No-direction, all-fractions-rejected and finite-budget stops remain unresolved. Numerical/domain/input/resource failures are failed; no stop establishes nonlinear stationarity or global optimality.

math.interpretation: Interior and artificial-step-boundary fixtures pass independent KKT. Physical-R0 and curved-SOC fixtures retain accurate finite but KKT-unresolved outcomes; qualification does not promise universal convergence.

orchestration.interpretation: Fabricated callbacks exercise full rejection/half-step acceptance, accepted-audit reuse, no direction, all rejection, model/round caps, metric failure, partial/unknown model work, partial optimizer work, unknown prior work and cumulative CPU admission. Stub resource records do not establish canonical resource performance.

independent_saved_fabricated_algebra.scope: Exact rational recomputation of saved four-fixture directional dot and quadratic-model arithmetic only; no proposal/prior/model invocation.

orchestration_and_receipts.input_isolation: Standalone new preflight uses public configuration and pinned observations; it does not call the old historical-candidate preflight. Disallowed historical, truth and prior-summary paths are rejected as inference source bindings. Every source is matched to the declared published Git blob and the immutable review map.
orchestration_and_receipts.durable_accounting: Child request and reservation are fsynced before launch. Model and external-prior slots are reserved before invocation; reported starts and completions remain separate. Unknown partial work retains incomplete status and reservations rather than zero work. Completed closure reconstructs counts from retained children and markers.
orchestration_and_receipts.closure: Sequential exact-child supervision is unchanged and pinned. The outer observer includes canonical-supervisor descendants and final inner closure in wait4 CPU/wall accounting, verifies raw child and source manifests, and includes its final receipt in combined output bytes. Its own bookkeeping RSS is separate; this is not a simultaneous aggregate-memory or target-SRAM qualification. Failed closure vetoes reporting; original raw capture names are preserved.
orchestration_and_receipts.post_inference_reporting: The standard-library reporter validates matching completed inner/outer closure and ownership before opening the pinned prior summary. It reuses that already-verified single endpoint truth record only for post-run point comparison. It performs zero raw-truth opens, new model/optimizer calls, prior-function evaluations, curvature inversions or interval/coverage tests.

KKT diagnoses the actual intersection with the artificial step box and retains distinct physical-support activity.
